extraction.Name: Millie Sully
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 22, 1918 by McManigal
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Royal Mutual Life Insurance Company for $3000 due May 11, 1923; conveyed to Harry L. Strom subject to the mortgage of $3000 on May 23, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612787 issued; Southeast quarter section 31, township 99, north of range 74; patent receipt signed by the allottee February 13, 1918; mortgage dated May 15, 1918; conveyance dated May 23, 1918; In 1913, a Lis pendens was filed against this land by Joe Kirby, probably owing to the law suit the Sullys filed against the United States in order to obtain their allotments
